svg.text: FARMPULSE — MOBILE / ONE THUMB, NO SIGNAL
Written to this device, then queued.
Nothing here waits on a signal.
Every change is saved on this device first,
then sent when it can be.
No sync server is configured yet.
Your work is safe: every change is
recorded in order on this device and
nothing is lost. Nothing has been sent.
One column, a five-item bar, and the add button within
thumb reach. The banner states the connection; nothing
else about the screen changes when it is gone.
Quantity, grade, moisture, batch, store: the detail a buyer
asks about, captured where the work happens and written
to the device before anything is sent anywhere.
The real count, the real last-sent time, and the plain reason
nothing has gone out. “Never” is a design decision —
unsent work has to look unsent.
